name: graphcommerce/magento-graphql-catalog
description: Catalog GraphQL fields for Magento 2 / Mage-OS: one custom attribute by code, the attribute metadata of a value and an aggregation, and the swatch of every option. One package with every module; each module directory is a package of its own for a subtree split.

suggest.magento/module-swatches-graph-ql: GraphCommerce_GraphQlCatalogSwatches serves the swatch of an aggregation option, an attribute option and a selected option
